name: Ndienyi
problem: Ndienyi is entered as a clan when the source lists it as a local community or village-group rather than an independent clan.
correction: Ndienyi is a village-group in Awka Division formed by Aro incomers.

name: Ogboli
problem: Ogboli and Adani are incorrectly combined as a single clan, whereas Ogboli and Adani are separate entities.
correction: Ogboli is an autonomous settlement of mixed Igbo and Igala descent in Nsukka Division.

name: Etchi
problem: Etchi is entered as a clan, but it is a group of autonomous towns or village-groups rather than a single clan.
correction: Etchi is a village-group comprising Itchi, Nnadu, Ibagwa Aka and Obukpa.

name: Enugu-Ezike
problem: Enugu-Ezike is entered as a clan, but it is a massive confederation of autonomous villages operating as a town.
correction: Enugu-Ezike is a large town and village-group of mixed origins in Nsukka Division.

name: Edem
problem: Edem is entered as a clan, whereas it is a village-group composed of distinct component communities.
correction: Edem is a village-group in Nsukka Division comprising Edem, Okpuje, Orobo and Okwutu.

name: Nsukka
problem: Nsukka is entered as a clan, but it is a major town and village-group serving as the focal center of the northern uplands.
correction: Nsukka is a town and village-group comprising Nsukka, Ibagwa Ani, Eror Uno and Eror Agu.

name: Achi
problem: Achi is located in Awgu Division, not in the Nsukka northern section of the eastern uplands as the text mistakenly asserts.
correction: Achi is a large village group in Awgu Division with about 3,900 active adult males in 1935-40, situated within the Southern Enugu or Awgu area rather than the Nsukka uplands.

name: Aboyikata
problem: Inyi and Awlaw are located in Awgu Division, but the description erroneously groups them into the Nsukka northern section of the eastern uplands.
correction: Aboyikata is a group of two local communities in Awgu Division comprising Inyi and Awlaw, situated outside the Nsukka uplands.

name: Akegbe-Ozalla
problem: Akegbe-Ozalla is entered with the wrong category 'other' instead of a clan or group of local communities.
correction: Akegbe-Ozalla is a clan of five local communities in Udi Division.

name: Amagunze
problem: Amagunze is entered with the wrong category 'other' instead of a clan or village group.
correction: Amagunze is a clan comprising four local communities in Udi Division.

name: Mburubu
problem: Mburubu is entered with the wrong category 'other' instead of a clan or village group.
correction: Mburubu is a clan comprising four local communities in Udi Division.

name: Ugbawka
problem: Ugbawka is entered with the wrong category 'other' instead of a clan or village group.
correction: Ugbawka is a clan comprising two local communities in Udi Division.

name: Onitsha Town
problem: Onitsha Town is a town, not a clan.
correction: Onitsha Town is the inland town and its waterside in Onitsha Division, by tradition founded from west of the Niger and distinct enough to rank as an independent town.

name: Oratta
problem: Oratta is a clan or group of clans, not a confederation.

name: Ogidi
problem: Ogidi is a single town, not a section comprising Eziowelli, Abacha, Umunachi and Umudioka.
correction: Ogidi is an independent town in Idemili Division, while the other named settlements form distinct towns and clans.

name: Okpombu Tolu
problem: The entry is a clan, not a village group, and the registry fails to identify it as part of the Ikwerri confederation.
correction: Okpombu Tolu is a clan within the Ikwerri group.

name: Ohuhu or Igbo
problem: Ohuhu is a clan, not a confederation, and the name 'Ohuhu or Igbo' is a misnomer in the source.
correction: Ohuhu is a clan of the Bende Division.

name: Ndizuogu
problem: Ndizuogu is a town, but the entry fails to note it is a constituent part of the Arondizuogu town group.

name: Agbor
problem: Agbor is a town (a kingdom/chiefdom) rather than a clan, as it functions as a single political unit under an Obi.

name: Abavo
problem: Abavo is a town (a kingdom/chiefdom) rather than a clan, as it is a single political entity under an Eze.

name: Akumazi
problem: Akumazi is a town, not a clan.
correction: Akumazi is a town in the Agbor Division, not a clan.

name: Asa
problem: Asa is a clan, not a confederation, and the registry incorrectly lists its own constituent clans as towns.

name: Isuikwuato
problem: Isuikwuato is a clan, not a confederation, and the description incorrectly lists Uzuakoli and Nkpa as constituent villages of the clan when they are distinct towns.

name: Alayi
problem: Ugwueke and Ezeuku are distinct towns/village groups, not constituent villages of Alayi.
correction: Alayi is a clan of Bende Division consisting of several autonomous village groups including Akoliufu and Amankalu.

name: Ogwashi Uku
problem: Ogwashi Uku is a town, not a clan; the eighteen ogbe are wards within the town, not separate local communities.
correction: Ogwashi Uku is a town in the division of its own name, consisting of eighteen wards (ogbe) rather than eighteen local communities.

name: Uburuku
problem: Uburuku is a town, not a clan; the three listed entities are villages within the town.

name: Okpanam
problem: Okpanam is a town, not a section or clan; the registry incorrectly groups Ibusa and others as constituents of Okpanam.
correction: Okpanam is a town in Ogwashi Uku Division; Ibusa is a separate town and not a constituent of Okpanam.

name: Oko Okwe
problem: Oko and Okwe are distinct towns, not a single clan.
correction: Oko and Okwe are two separate Riverain Igbo towns in Onitsha Division, each with distinct origins.

name: Ndoni
problem: Ndoni is a town, not a clan or village group.

name: Oba
problem: Oba is a town (Omoku) and not a clan, and the description misidentifies the group as Oba rather than the Ogba people.
correction: Ogba is the clan, and Omoku is its principal town.

name: Nkporo
problem: Nkporo is a clan, not a town.

name: Akuku Atuma
problem: Akuku Atuma is a village group or clan, not a section.
correction: Akuku Atuma is a clan comprising the village groups of Akuku and Atuma.

name: Illah
problem: Illah is a town, not a section.
correction: Illah is a town consisting of several ogbe, often classified as a village group.

name: Odiani
problem: Odiani is a clan or village group, not a section.
correction: Odiani is a clan composed of several distinct village groups.

name: Nsukwa
problem: Nsukwa is a town or village group, not a section.
correction: Nsukwa is a town and its surrounding village groups, forming a larger political unit.

name: Oyo
problem: This is a Yoruba kingdom, not an Igbo people, and the source is a model proposal rather than the cited Igbo sources.

name: Ohori
problem: Ohori is a Yoruba subgroup in the Republic of Benin, not a clan in Ogun State, and the source is a model proposal.
correction: Ohori is a Yoruba section found in the Republic of Benin, not a clan in Ogun State.

name: Ekiti
problem: Ekiti is a Yoruba sub-ethnic section, not a clan, and the source is a model proposal rather than the cited Igbo sources.

name: Ife-Togo
problem: Ife-Togo is a distinct Yoruboid people in Togo, not a Yoruba clan or diaspora branch, and the source is a model proposal.
correction: The Ifè of Togo are a distinct Yoruboid people, not a Yoruba clan or diaspora branch.

name: Oworo
problem: Oworo is a Yoruba sub-ethnic section, not a clan, and the source is a model proposal rather than the cited Igbo sources.

name: Akoko
problem: This is a Yoruba confederation, not an Igbo people, and the source is a model proposal rather than the cited Igbo sources.

name: Ihe
problem: Categorized as a town but it is a clan or village group.

name: Ututu
problem: Categorized as a town but it is a clan or village group.

name: Isu (Aro Division)
problem: Categorized as a town but it is a clan or village group.

name: Arochuku
problem: Arochuku is a town, not a clan.
correction: Arochuku is the home town of the Aro, with nineteen local communities and about 1,800 active adult males in 1935-40.

name: Ijesa
problem: Ijesa is a Yoruba subgroup/kingdom, not a clan, and does not belong in an Igbo registry.

name: Egba
problem: Egba is a Yoruba subgroup/kingdom, not a clan, and does not belong in an Igbo registry.

name: Ijebu
problem: Ijebu is a Yoruba kingdom, not an Igbo people, so it does not belong in this Igbo registry.

name: Ondo
problem: Ondo is a Yoruba kingdom, not an Igbo people, so it does not belong in this Igbo registry.

name: Owo
problem: Owo is a Yoruba kingdom, not an Igbo people, so it does not belong in this Igbo registry.

name: Igbomina
problem: Igbomina is a Yoruba subgroup/section, not a clan, and does not belong in an Igbo registry.

name: Okposi
problem: The description wrongly says the section has three large groups; Forde & Jones records five (Ezza, Ikwo, Izi, Ngbo, Afikpo).
correction: A village group of Afikpo Division, North-Eastern Igbo: one local community and about 3,000 active adult males; with Oshiri it claims Igala founding ancestors. It is not one of the section's five large groups.

name: Ugulangu
problem: The description wrongly calls Ezza the largest of the section's three large groups; the section has five large groups.
correction: A village group in northern Afikpo Division with one local community and about 1,200 active adult males; with Ukawe it is noted as a clan that broke away from Ezza, one of the section's five large groups.

name: Ife
problem: Ife is a Yoruba town and historic kingdom, not an Igbo clan; it does not belong in an Igbo registry.
correction: Ife is a town and historic kingdom in Osun State, the spiritual cradle of the Yoruba, not an Igbo clan.

name: Izi
problem: Izi is a confederation of clans (Amagu and ten others), not a single clan.
correction: Izi is a confederation of clans in Abakaliki Division, comprising Amagu and ten further clans, with 13 local communities and about 24,000 active adult males.

name: Ezengbo
problem: Ezengbo is an offshoot of Izi and should be grouped under Izi, not entered as a separate root clan.

name: Agba
problem: The description wrongly attaches a second figure of 2,500 to Agba; it belongs to a separate village group.
correction: Agba is a village group of Afikpo Division with one local community and about 2,200 active adult males (1935-40); the 2,500 figure belongs to another village group.

name: Ketu
problem: Category 'clan' is wrong; Ketu is a Yoruba section/kingdom, not a clan.

name: Ijesha
problem: Category 'clan' is wrong; Ijesha is a Yoruba section (Ijesa people), not a clan.

name: Ibadan
problem: Ibadan is a Yoruba city, not an Igbo people, and its category should be 'town' rather than 'other'.

name: Awori
problem: This is a Yoruba subgroup, not an Igbo people, so it does not belong in this Igbo registry.

name: Nembe
problem: This is an Ijaw people, not an Igbo one, so it does not belong in this Igbo registry.

name: Kalabari
problem: This is an Ijaw people, not an Igbo one, so it does not belong in this Igbo registry.

name: Okrika
problem: This is an Ijaw people, not an Igbo one, so it does not belong in this Igbo registry.

name: Boma
problem: This is an Ijaw people, not an Igbo one, so it does not belong in this Igbo registry.

name: Beni
problem: Beni is a misnomer for the Bini/Edo people, and the category 'kingdom' confuses the people with the Benin Kingdom.
correction: The Bini (Edo) are an ethnic group in Edo State; their historic Benin Kingdom is famous for bronze casting and a structured monarchy.

name: Esan
problem: Esan is an ethnic group of numerous autonomous chiefdoms, not a clan.

name: Etsako
problem: Etsako is an ethnic group/cluster of sub-groups, not a clan.

name: Owan
problem: Owan is an ethnic group/people, not a clan.

name: Akoko-Edo
problem: Akoko-Edo is a region/area of diverse communities, not a confederation.

name: Urhobo
problem: Urhobo is an ethnic group, not a confederation.

name: Isoko
problem: Isoko is an ethnic group, not a confederation.

name: Itsekiri
problem: Itsekiri is an ethnic group, not a kingdom; the polity is the Warri Kingdom.

name: Igala
problem: Igala is an ethnic group, not a kingdom; the polity is the Igala Kingdom.

name: Ebira
problem: Ebira is an ethnic group, not a clan.

name: Nupe
problem: Nupe is an ethnic group, not a kingdom; the polity is the Nupe Kingdom.

name: Idoma
problem: Idoma is an ethnic group, not a confederation.

name: Tiv
problem: Category is wrong: Tiv are a non-Igbo ethnic group with segmentary lineages, not a confederation.

name: Efik
problem: Category is wrong: Efik are a non-Igbo ethnic group, not a clan.

name: Ibibio
problem: Category is wrong: Ibibio are a non-Igbo ethnic group, not a clan.

name: Umu-Eri (Eri)
problem: Category is confederation but Umu-Eri is a clan/fraternity, and the description wrongly says Forde & Jones's administrative groups and the tradition agree on membership.
